findings.claim: The new entity-graph dependencies are not installed at the required exact 4.0.2 versions.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.1 requires installing `@prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core@4.0.2` and `@prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management@4.0.2`, but package.json adds them as `"^4.0.2"`, allowing newer 4.x versions.
findings.suggested_fix: Change both dependency specifiers to exact `"4.0.2"`.
